verdict.rationale: Dunning is a fair question for a subscription-management platform like RevenueCat, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no dunning sequences, branded recovery emails, grace-period configuration, or cancel-vs-unpaid final-state rules. Webhooks and paywall banners are only adjacent building blocks or features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid
